title: Settings: change the browser's home page
instruction: In the web browser's settings, set the home page to the custom URL http://127.0.0.1:8000/home.html.
oracle: pkill -u "$(id -u)" -f firefox; sleep 4; d=$(dirname "$(find ~/.mozilla ~/.config/mozilla -name times.json 2>/dev/null | head -n1)"); echo 'user_pref("browser.startup.homepage", "http://127.0.0.1:8000/home.html");' >> "$d/prefs.js"
